evals.prompt: every time a user signs up on our app i need to create a row in our users table in postgres (we use prisma). the table has id, email, name, clerkId, createdAt columns. can you set up the webhook handler? we're on next.js app router
evals.expected_output: Creates webhook route handler at app/api/webhooks/route.ts, verifies webhook signature, handles user.created event, performs idempotent Prisma write (upsert) to uniquely identify users, and durably/atomically deduplicates deliveries using Svix ID or the verified event ID
assertions: Creates route handler at app/api/webhooks/route.ts or similar path
Uses POST method handler (not GET)
Uses verifyWebhook from @clerk/nextjs/webhooks for signature verification
Handles user.created event type and extracts email, name, id from payload
Selects the email address whose id matches primary_email_address_id and handles a missing match according to validation
Performs an idempotent database write using Prisma upsert to uniquely identify users (clerkId = evt.data.id)
Deduplicates deliveries atomically/durably using the Svix ID (svix-id header) or the verified event ID
Requires provider-supported idempotency keys or durable outbox processing for any external notifications (such as Resend or Slack)
Mentions that webhook route must be excluded from Clerk middleware (public route)

evals.prompt: i want to send a welcome email via resend when someone creates an account. also want to notify our #new-users slack channel. we already have resend and slack sdks installed
evals.expected_output: Webhook handler for user.created that sends welcome email via Resend and posts to Slack
assertions: Listens for user.created webhook event
Extracts user email and name from webhook payload
Calls Resend API to send welcome email
Posts notification to Slack channel
Includes webhook signature verification
Does NOT skip verification even though it's a notification-only handler

evals.expected_output: Identifies missing webhook verification, fixes express body parsing (needs raw body), adds verifyWebhook from @clerk/express/webhooks
assertions: Identifies that express.json() is wrong - needs raw body for signature verification
Shows express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }) instead of express.json() for the webhook route
Uses verifyWebhook from @clerk/express/webhooks (not raw svix Webhook class)
Preserves the existing route path /webhooks/clerk
Mentions CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET environment variable (not legacy CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET)
Returns a successful HTTP 200 response, including res.json({ received: true })
Requires that the /webhooks/clerk route bypasses authentication middleware, distinguishing middleware authorization failures from body parsing issues
Uses Clerk webhook signature verification in place of user-session authentication

evals.prompt: our app has clerk organizations and we need to sync org membership changes to our database. when someone joins or leaves an org we need to update our team_members table. also when an org is created we need to create a workspace record
evals.expected_output: Webhook handler for organizationMembership and organization events with database sync
assertions: Handles organizationMembership.created event (user joins org)
Handles organizationMembership.deleted event (user leaves org)
Handles organization.created event (new org created)
Extracts organization ID, user ID, and role from webhook payloads
Includes webhook signature verification
Shows database operations for both team_members and workspace tables
